message.content:
**Uno – Quick‑Start Rules** | Section | What you need to know | |---------|-----------------------| | **Goal** | Be the first player to score 500 points (or whatever house rule you set). Points are tallied from the cards left in opponents’ hands when you finish a round. | | **Deck** | 108 cards: 4 colors (Red, Yellow, Green, Blue) × 25 cards each (one 0, two 1–9, two “Skip”, two “Reverse”, two “Draw Two”) + 4 “Wild” + 4 “Wild Draw Four”. | | **Setup** | 1. Shuffle the deck. 2. Deal 7 cards to each player. 3. Place the remaining deck face‑down as the draw pile. 4. Flip the top card of the draw pile to start the discard pile. If it’s a special card, apply its effect immediately. | | **Turn Order** | Players take turns clockwise (unless a Reverse card changes direction). On your turn you must either:
• **Play** one card that matches the discard pile’s color, number, or symbol, or
• **Draw** one card from the draw pile. If that card can be played, you may play it immediately; otherwise the turn ends. | | **Card Types** | • **Number cards** – play if same color or same number.
• **Skip** – next player loses a turn.
• **Reverse** – changes play direction.
• **Draw Two** – next player draws two cards and loses a turn.
• **Wild** – you choose the new color.
• **Wild Draw Four** – you choose the new color; next player draws four cards and loses a turn. (Can only be played if you have no other playable card; otherwise you can be challenged.) | | **Calling “Uno”** | When you have only one card left, shout “UNO!” before the next player takes their turn. If you forget and another player catches you, you must draw two penalty cards. | | **Winning a Round** | The first player to discard all their cards wins the round. | | **Scoring** | Add up the point values of the cards left in each opponent’s hand:
• Number cards = face value.
• Skip, Reverse, Draw Two = 20 points.
• Wild, Wild Draw Four = 50 points.
Winner gets that total added to their score. | | **Game End** | Play continues until a player reaches the target score (usually 500). | **House‑Rule Variations (optional)** - **Stacking**: Allow players to stack Draw Two or Wild Draw Four cards instead of drawing immediately. - **No “Wild Draw Four” challenge**: Simplify by letting anyone play it regardless of hand. - **Different target score**: 300, 1000, etc. That’s the core of Uno! Enjoy the colorful chaos.
